lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance spots are organized into a regular grid, forming vertical columns of approximately 4-5 spots between faint transverse bands.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal carinae, creating rectangular nodes where high-luminance blobs are centrally positioned.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal carinae are visible along the mid-to-upper flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower-left quadrant displays a high-density cluster of smaller, high-contrast white spots compared to the flank patterning.
